note: cfg_c handoff, plus one contact rule. For the first 0.40 s after the command rate rises through 2 deg/s, a phase-selected right hip whose sole has more than 55% of the sole load gets the opposite sign. After 0.40 s the sign matches cfg_c. The swing right hip is never flipped. Gains are not reduced. Holding the flip for the whole slew was measured and dropped: fresh 90 deg finishes fell 20 to 30 deg short. Half-turns are not in this file's qualification because pitch falls near -43 deg still reproduce on seeds that walk those horizons straight.
